description: A serene minimalist bedroom vignette photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing an off-center composition that shows the left side of the bed and the adjacent floating nightstand. The back wall is fully clad in light natural oak wood paneling with a clean horizontal grain, running from floor to ceiling and creating a warm sandy tone throughout the backdrop. Near the ceiling, a continuous warm amber glow runs horizontally just below the crown, emanating from a cove or reveal detail that separates the wood paneling from the white ceiling plane, bathing the entire upper wall in a soft gradient of warm light. The nightstand is a wall-hung drawer unit in the same light oak as the paneling, with clean hardware-free drawer fronts. On its surface sit two slim hardcover books stacked flat, topped with a small matte ceramic bud vase in pale putty holding a spray of tiny dried yellow flowers. The bed features a rounded upholstered headboard in warm dove-grey linen, dressed in a quilted white coverlet with a diamond stitch pattern and a folded dark charcoal chunky knit throw across the foot. The overall palette is pale sand, ivory, and soft grey with charcoal accents — deeply calm.
